title: Report initialization and outcome
responsibility: Creates an active report and derives an outcome from its recorded items.

inputs.name: reportState.input
inputs.description: Project, title and feature/suite mode, with optional environment, revision, historical flag, summary and acceptance.

inputs.name: resultStatus.report
inputs.description: Report whose checks, findings, coverage and evidence determine the result.

inputs.name: interrupted.report
inputs.description: Report whose unfinished inactivity should be detected.

outputs.name: reportState
outputs.description: Sanitized new report with UUID, project identity derived from the resolved path, matching creation/update timestamps, running/active state and empty result arrays. Environment defaults to local, summary to empty and acceptance to an empty array.

outputs.name: resultStatus
outputs.description: Failed if any item failed; otherwise blocked if any item is blocked, not-proven, interrupted or running. With no checks returns not-proven; all skipped checks return skipped; otherwise passed.

outputs.name: interrupted
outputs.description: True for a nonfinalized report whose last update was more than fifteen minutes ago, using the current clock.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws when project or title is falsy, or mode is neither feature nor suite.
